title: Cancellation Timing and the Protected Rebooking Price of Free Night Awards
content:
For one of the Free Night Awards returned from a night after the first night of a reservation cancelled after its deadline, how close to arrival the late cancellation was recorded decides how the protected rebooking price is set. The days are counted as whole calendar days from the date the cancellation was recorded to the arrival date of the cancelled reservation, both as shown on its Room Reservations record (the moment the cancellation was recorded, read as a hotel local date).

## Schedule

| When the late cancellation was recorded | Whole calendar days from cancellation date to arrival date | The returned night is protected at |
|---|---|---|
| On the arrival date or later | 0 or fewer | The peak-season price of the cancelled reservation's category plus one more season step |
| On the calendar day before the arrival date | 1 | That category's peak-season price |
| Two or more days before the arrival date, which a deadline further out than one day makes possible | 2 or more | The stay's protected value itself, as recorded on the loss record of the stay's first-night award |

## Ashbury Rewards award chart figures used by the schedule

The award chart's standard-season prices by category are those of the Ashbury Rewards award chart. A category's season step is the gap between its neighbouring seasons on that chart; its peak-season price is its standard-season price plus one season step and its off-peak price its standard-season price less one season step.

| Category | Standard-season price | Season step | Peak-season price | Peak-season price plus one more season step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 7500 | 2500 | 10000 | 12500 |
| 2 | 12500 | 2500 | 15000 | 17500 |
| 3 | 17500 | 2500 | 20000 | 22500 |
| 4 | 25000 | 5000 | 30000 | 35000 |
| 5 | 35000 | 5000 | 40000 | 45000 |
| 6 | 45000 | 5000 | 50000 | 55000 |
| 7 | 60000 | 10000 | 70000 | 80000 |
| 8 | 85000 | 15000 | 100000 | 115000 |

The category is the award category recorded on the cancelled reservation.

## Boundary days (hypothetical category 4 reservation arriving on 12 May)

| Cancellation recorded on | Days to arrival | Protected at |
|---|---|---|
| 13 May | Arrival date passed | 35000 |
| 12 May | 0 | 35000 |
| 11 May | 1 | 30000 |
| 10 May | 2 | The stay's protected value on the first-night award's loss record |
